verdict.what_happens: The first domino falls to the right and knocks down the remaining nine in sequence, leaving all ten substantially tilted in an overlapping fallen row.

usage.text:
The first domino falls to the right, starting a toppling wave through all ten. The side-view trails show them rotating down into a low, overlapping arrangement, with the last domino falling beyond the row’s end. The plan view shows the cascade staying aligned. All ten appear tilted well beyond 15° from upright.
